title: The aunt
html_source:
Typical language of people across the world’s hemispheres.

I’ve actually only heard Western and English cultures use the word “The” & then a relative to establish that they’re talking about their own family member.

For example:

“The wife says I need to eat better.”

“The hubby thinks I’m cheating.”
